# The appointments Asanga made — and who is keeping them

The mistake is reading myths as entertainment. Asanga's cycle reads more like a charter — each story assigning a duty the modern world still pays for.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Asanga
- **Pantheon:** Buddhist
- **Domain of influence:** Yogacara, Mind-Only
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Society & Spirit · Culture & Entertainment
- **Strongest seat:** Education, Research & Knowledge
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 55 of 546

## The Cycle, Read Forward

### Education, Research & Knowledge — through *Origins*

Asanga appears in buddhist tradition as yogacara, mind-only.  The name's meaning, "Without attachment", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Primary seat: Asanga embodies yogacara, mind-only — the core of education.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. That is the cycle working: story becomes duty, duty becomes trade.

### Mythic Name Restoration — through *Worship and Memory*

Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Asanga in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Resonant seat: Asanga shares symbolic territory with mythic restoration.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

### Writing, Publishing & Media — through *Origins*

Asanga appears in buddhist tradition as yogacara, mind-only.  The name's meaning, "Without attachment", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Resonant seat: Asanga shares symbolic territory with publishing media.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

## The Theme That Runs the Cycle

The stories of Asanga place yogacara, mind-only at the center of a living mythological world.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

Skeptical? Good — the system is built for you. Every seat in this file carries its why-line and its weight, the full derivation is public at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/), and the challenge process is part of the design. Falsifiable is not a posture here; it is the mechanism.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in education, research & knowledge, mythic name restoration, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/asanga/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
